title: Use PositionedDirectional in TutoredChildrenSection's pending-invite count badge instead of physical right:
why: AX-1 bans physical left:/right: positioning in this RTL (Hebrew) app; EdgeInsets.only(left:/right:) and Alignment.centerLeft/Right are the named examples but Positioned(right:) is the same class of bug and isn't caught by the current grep (which only targets EdgeInsets/Alignment APIs) or by any of the 22 make audit checks (confirmed clean on this exact tree). In Hebrew/RTL the pending-invite count badge stays pinned to the physical right of the mail icon instead of mirroring to the leading/'start' corner like directional UI elsewhere in the app.
recommendation: Wrap with PositionedDirectional(top: 6, end: 6, ...) — the Stack is already inside an ambient Directionality via MaterialApp.
acceptance_criteria: Positioned(...right:...) no longer appears in tutored_children_section.dart
The root Makefile's AX-1 grep is extended to also flag Positioned(...left:/right:...)
